title: Personalized News Recommendation: Methods and Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Decomposing click prediction scores into a bias score and a bias-independent user preference score to mitigate the influence of news display positions and sizes on webpages.
Separately modeling the popularity of news and users' personal preferences to learn calibrated user interest representations and eliminate the disproportionately higher click chances of popular news.

Measuring the accuracy of sensitive attribute (e.g., gender) prediction based on top recommendation results to evaluate consumer-side fairness, where higher accuracy indicates more serious unfairness.

Calculating Equity Attention for group fairness (EAGF) and Supplier Popularity Deviation (SPD) metrics to evaluate recommendation fairness and exposure equity across different groups of authors or publishers.
